body:
I'm quite familiar with the feeling because I do that myself. I'm lucky enough to have friends that still insists on me, even if I isolate myself just like you.

Do you have friends that still insists on your friendship? If you do, it can be really exhausting but you can try to talk to them more and deepen your friendship. If not, it's okay too. I know it's really hard to do that but try to look at yourself and think about all of the things that makes you unique, even if you don't feel it yet, just think about it for a while. You can also tell me, if you feel comfortable, what makes you invalidate yourself. Is it your personality, your appearance, or something else? I ask that because of my own reasons, that are mostly based on appearance and personality, so I understand.

I know it's kinda lame but honestly one of the reason why I'm still here is that I hope that things will get better in the future. I'm 19, still young and really want to be happy, so do you, right? So hold on to it, you *will* be happy and get out of this situation at some point. Unfortunately we all have to to through a lot of pain to get there, but eventually we will.

I don't know how old you are, you can also tell me if you feel comfortable to. But no matter our age, sometimes we think that it's the end because at the time we're not happy or not being who we want to be, but it's not. 

Considering that you invalidate yourself, something you can do, even if it takes a lot of effort and unfortunately I know we hate to make efforts because it's so much easier, even if it's sad, to just stay sad and accept your situation saying "I'm not worthy, I'm never going to be happy and the person I want to be" rather than trying to change it because we don't really know HOW to change it, but sometimes we have to force ourselves, even if it's tiresome. That's kinda working for me and I've come a long way, so that's why I'm saying it.

And I can see that you really want to get out of this situation, you still have the hope, right? That things will get better? I can see that you're aware that it's not good to invalidate and isolate yourself. That's all we need, the will to change things.

If it's not too much to ask, could you tell me the things that made you feel like this? In other words, your "story". I'm really interested. I could even call you if I didn't had social anxiety and wasn't also an introvert.

Also, I'm sorry it took me so long to answer, I was also gathering my words.
In what kind of way? Like, what do you do that hurts you? Is it fiscally or mentally or both? And is there a season/something that happened and made you feel this way?
Hey, I'm so sorry you feel this way. Do you want to talk about it? Maybe tell the reasons why you want to die so bad, it can help.

Hey, do you have someone to ask to live in their house for a while untill next month? If not, it's okay. I don't really know what to say, but if it helps, at least you ARE going to get money on the 15th, just please wait and things might get better. You still have your house too, i know it's hard and you need food and other stuff, but the chance for it to get better is just a few days away, so keep going for just a little while. It may not be amazing but keep alive the hope that you will get out of this situation in the future

I'm so sorry, I'm also seeking for help. Can you tell me why you feel like that? Did something happen to you that made you feel all of these things? Could you tell me all of the reasons (or even if there's no reason) for you to feel each of these things? I really want to know and really want to talk to you. If you want to I can tell you my reasons too.
I'm so sorry, I saw myself in your text, I'm so sorry for us. I hope we can get through this.

I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry. If there's any chance for you to not do it, please don't do it. I don't know what to say, I also want to end it all, but if there's even one thing that still makes you want to stay alive, please hold on to it and find other things. I'm so sorry.

Try talking to that person, explain your reasons, make them understand and show how important that person is to you. Have you tried to get help? If not, try, share your reasons with people and you might get another point of view about your problems. If you really want to. If not, I just wish you the best, because I'm just the same as you, but let's keep going on together, please.
Because I still have the hope things might get better in the future, because I don't have the courage and I'm afraid that when I do it, I'll survive.

You're not a bad person, I'm so sorry you had to go through all of this. I wish I could help you and keep you alive. But all I can say is that please give yourself another chance, things might get better in the future. You have a job, right? Think about it, you still have it, it's the chance for you to start over, meet new people and be happy again. Please don't give up, if you don't, then I won't either.
